name: Sz 97
notes: Extremely compact Class II disk, R68 ~7 au; ALMA Band 7 0.87 mm (Curone et al. 2026)

paper.title: Probing Planet Formation within 10 au: Dust Substructures in Extremely Compact Protoplanetary Disks

images.note: Panel label inside figure: Sz 97. R68 = 6.57 au (0.0421"). Substructure detected in the image plane and confirmed in visibilities and frank profile: gap D4 at 3.9 au (depth I_D/I_B = 0.85) and ring B6 at 5.7 au. Beam 19x13 mas = 3.0x2.0 au, PA_b = 90 deg; F_nu = 5.01 +/- 0.53 mJy; rms 47 uJy/beam. EBs 29 Jul and 04 Aug 2025; epoch = first EB.
